## Intent — what this is for

An optional desktop companion surface (watchlist, reminders, day-planning). Charm/retention; strictly opt-in; coordinates with COMPANION-APPS/DESKTOP surfaces.

## Done when

The companion app ships as its own validated PersonalClawApps PR built to the app-creation contract (app.json, SDK-only imports, minimum permissions, test_provider.py/test_server.py, README, LICENSE), validated by adding it as a local Store source and driving it in the real UI; listed in the Store and recorded in ECOSYSTEM-TOOLING's exemplar list; every surface is opt-in and disabling it removes all its triggers.
